decision_rule: HIP build qualification only: pinned v10 and diagnostic patch; exact generated modes source/header hashes; full executable with rollback/verify-batch/fault markers; GGML_HIP ON and gfx90a CMake binding; hashed libggml-hip with compiled HIP registration and gfx90a image marker; all llama/ggml linkage local to this build. No native model execution, rollback, residency or performance verdict. Stop on validated full receipt; futility on source mismatch, build/linkage failure, STOP or deadline.
